description: This Java class defines a Spring component named AccountTransfersMapper that implements RowMapper to map SQL query result rows into AccountTransferData objects. It constructs a complex SQL schema query in its constructor and uses that schema to parse database result set entries related to account transfer transactions, including related entities like offices, clients, currencies, and accounts.

classes.name: AccountTransfersMapper
classes.description: A Spring @Component class implementing RowMapper to transform SQL result set rows into AccountTransferData objects, encapsulating database schema details and row mapping logic.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the SQL schema query string used for retrieving account transfer data from the database.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a single row of the ResultSet to an AccountTransferData object, extracting all relevant fields and associated entities.
